points.title: 贵族教育
points.description: 尼赫鲁出生于印度北方邦阿拉哈巴德的一个富裕的克什米尔潘迪特家庭。他的父亲莫蒂拉尔·尼赫鲁是著名的律师和国大党领导人。尼赫鲁接受了英国式教育，先后在哈罗公学学习，后在剑桥大学三一学院攻读法律。这段经历使他接触了西方思想，同时也让他深刻感受到印度与西方之间的文化差异，为他后来追求印度独立埋下了思想种子。
points.descriptionEn: Nehru was born in Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh, into a wealthy Kashmiri Brahmin family. His father, Motilal Nehru, was a prominent lawyer and Indian National Congress leader. Nehru received a Western-style education, first at Harrow School and later at Trinity College, Cambridge, where he studied law. This exposure to Western ideas, coupled with the cultural differences he observed between India and the West, planted the seeds for his later pursuit of Indian independence.

points.title: 投身政治
points.description: 回到印度后，尼赫鲁在阿拉哈巴德开始了律师生涯，但很快被政治吸引。1912年，他加入印度国民大会党，受到甘地领导的非暴力不合作运动的深刻影响。1916年，他结识了甘地，两人建立了深厚的友谊和合作关系。1919年，阿姆利则惨案后，尼赫鲁彻底放弃了对英国统治的幻想，全心投入印度独立运动。这一时期，他开始形成自己的政治理念，强调社会主义和现代化对印度的重要性。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to India, Nehru began his legal practice in Allahabad but was quickly drawn to politics. He joined the Indian National Congress in 1912 and was deeply influenced by Gandhi's Non-Cooperation Movement. In 1916, he met Gandhi and formed a deep friendship and working relationship. Following the Jallianwala Bagh massacre in 1919, Nehru abandoned all illusions about British rule and devoted himself to the Indian independence movement. During this period, he began to develop his own political philosophy, emphasizing the importance of socialism and modernization for India.

points.title: 独立运动领袖
points.description: 在接下来的二十多年里，尼赫鲁成为印度独立运动的核心领导人之一。他多次因参与独立运动被捕入狱，累计监禁时间超过九年。1936年，他当选为国大党主席，开始推动国大党的社会主义议程。1942年，他参与发起'退出印度'运动，再次被捕。这一时期，尼赫鲁与甘地、帕特尔等领导人共同领导了印度的独立斗争，同时积极构建未来独立印度的政治蓝图。他主张建立一个世俗、民主、社会主义的印度，并开始培养新一代的政治领导人。
points.descriptionEn: Over the next two decades, Nehru emerged as one of the central leaders of the Indian independence movement. He was imprisoned multiple times for his involvement in the independence struggle, serving over nine years in jail. In 1936, he was elected President of the Indian National Congress and began promoting the party's socialist agenda. In 1942, he participated in the Quit India Movement and was imprisoned again. During this period, Nehru worked alongside leaders like Gandhi and Patel to lead India's struggle for independence while simultaneously laying the political blueprint for a future independent India. He advocated for a secular, democratic, and socialist India and began mentoring a new generation of political leaders.

points.title: 首任总理
points.description: 1947年印度独立后，尼赫鲁成为印度首任总理，并一直担任这一职务直至1964年去世。作为总理，他面临着艰巨的任务：整合数百个土邦、处理印巴分治的难民危机、建立民主制度和经济基础。他推行五年计划，推动工业化，建立公营部门，并倡导不结盟外交政策，使印度在国际舞台上保持独立立场。他还致力于推动教育普及和科学进步，建立了印度理工学院等著名教育机构。这一时期，尼赫鲁塑造了现代印度的政治、经济和社会结构，其影响延续至今。
points.descriptionEn: After India's independence in 1947, Nehru became the country's first Prime Minister, serving in this position until his death in 1964. As Prime Minister, he faced monumental tasks: integrating hundreds of princely states, handling the refugee crisis from the Partition of India, and establishing democratic institutions and economic foundations. He implemented Five-Year Plans, promoted industrialization, established a public sector, and pursued a non-aligned foreign policy that kept India independent on the international stage. He also focused on education and scientific advancement, establishing institutions like the Indian Institutes of Technology. During this period, Nehru shaped the political, economic, and social structure of modern India, with effects that continue to this day.

points.title: 宪法制定
points.description: 作为制宪会议的领导者，尼赫鲁在新德里主持制定了印度宪法。他确保宪法确立了印度作为一个世俗、民主共和国的基础，保障公民基本权利，同时保留了中央集权的联邦结构。尼赫鲁亲自起草了宪法序言，其中'我们印度人民...'的表述成为印度民主的标志性宣言。这一宪法框架奠定了印度政治制度的基础，使印度成为世界上最大的民主国家。尼赫鲁在宪法制定过程中展现了其政治远见，平衡了理想与现实，确保了印度多元社会的包容性。
points.descriptionEn: As leader of the Constituent Assembly, Nehru presided over the drafting of the Indian Constitution in New Delhi. He ensured the constitution established India as a secular, democratic republic with fundamental rights for citizens while maintaining a centralized federal structure. Nehru personally drafted the Preamble, with its opening words 'We, the People of India...' becoming an iconic declaration of Indian democracy. This constitutional framework laid the foundation for India's political system, making it the world's largest democracy. During the constitution-making process, Nehru demonstrated political vision by balancing ideals with reality and ensuring inclusivity for India's diverse society.

points.title: 不结盟运动
points.description: 尼赫鲁积极推动亚洲团结和不结盟外交政策，与埃及的纳赛尔、南斯拉夫的铁托和印尼的苏加诺共同发起不结盟运动。1954年，他提出'和平共处五项原则'，成为指导中国与印度关系的基础。1955年，他参加万隆会议，促进亚非国家的团结与合作。尼赫鲁的不结盟政策使印度在冷战期间保持了独立立场，避免了卷入美苏两大阵营的对抗，同时也提升了印度在国际舞台上的地位和影响力。这一外交理念至今仍是印度外交政策的重要基石。
points.descriptionEn: Nehru actively promoted Asian unity and a non-aligned foreign policy, co-founding the Non-Aligned Movement with Egypt's Nasser, Yugoslavia's Tito, and Indonesia's Sukarno. In 1954, he proposed the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence, which became the basis for Sino-Indian relations. In 1955, he attended the Bandung Conference, promoting solidarity and cooperation among Asian and African nations. Nehru's non-aligned policy allowed India to maintain independence during the Cold War, avoiding entanglement in the US-Soviet rivalry while enhancing India's status and influence on the international stage. This diplomatic philosophy remains a cornerstone of India's foreign policy to this day.

appraisal.zh: 尼赫鲁被普遍视为现代印度的建筑师，他领导这个新独立的国家走上民主、世俗与社会主义的道路，建立公营部门与科学教育体系，并以不结盟政策维护印度的国际独立性，其学者气质的形象深入人心。不过也有研究者指出，他的经济政策过于理想化、忽视私营部门，中央集权削弱地方自治，1962年中印边界战争的决策失误也受到指责，其家族政治更被指为后来的政治世袭埋下伏笔。
appraisal.en: Nehru is generally regarded as the architect of modern India, leading the newly independent nation along a democratic, secular, and socialist path, building a public sector and scientific education system, and upholding India's international independence through non-alignment; his scholarly statesman image remains iconic. Yet some researchers note that his economic policies were overly idealistic and neglected the private sector, that his centralizing tendencies weakened local autonomy, that his miscalculations in the 1962 Sino-Indian border war drew criticism, and that his family politics paved the way for later dynastic politics.

supporter.zh: 尼赫鲁被誉为现代印度的建筑师，他的远见卓识为印度奠定了民主、世俗和社会主义的基础。支持者认为他成功地将一个分裂的殖民地转变为统一的民主国家，建立了强大的公营部门和科学教育体系。他的不结盟政策使印度在国际舞台上保持了独立性和尊严，同时促进了亚洲国家的团结。尼赫鲁还致力于消除种姓歧视和促进性别平等，为印度的社会进步做出了重要贡献。
supporter.en: Nehru is hailed as the architect of modern India, whose vision laid the foundations for a democratic, secular, and socialist nation. Supporters credit him with successfully transforming a divided colony into a unified democracy, establishing a strong public sector and scientific education system. His non-aligned policy maintained India's independence and dignity on the international stage while promoting solidarity among Asian nations. Nehru also worked to eliminate caste discrimination and promote gender equality, making significant contributions to India's social progress.

critic.zh: 批评者认为尼赫鲁的经济政策过于理想化，忽视了私营部门的重要性，导致印度长期经济增长缓慢。他的中央集权倾向削弱了地方自治，加剧了中央与邦之间的紧张关系。在处理中印边界问题上，批评者指责他的外交决策失误导致了1962年的战争。此外，尼赫鲁对社会主义的执着和对市场经济的排斥，使印度错过了早期经济发展的机会。他的家族政治也为后来的印度政治世袭化埋下了伏笔。
critic.en: Critics argue that Nehru's economic policies were overly idealistic, neglecting the importance of the private sector and leading to India's slow economic growth for decades. His centralizing tendencies weakened local autonomy and increased tensions between the central and state governments. In handling the Sino-Indian border issue, critics blame his diplomatic miscalculations for the 1962 war. Additionally, Nehru's insistence on socialism and rejection of market economy caused India to miss early opportunities for economic development. His family politics also laid the groundwork for the subsequent dynastic nature of Indian politics.

objective.zh: 历史学界普遍认为尼赫鲁是印度独立后最具影响力的领导人之一，他的政策塑造了现代印度的发展轨迹。在流行文化中，尼赫鲁常被描绘为具有学者气质的政治家，他的红色领巾和山羊胡成为标志性形象。尽管他的经济政策存在争议，但他在建立民主制度、促进教育和科学进步方面的成就得到广泛认可。尼赫鲁的遗产是复杂的，既有成功也有失败，但他对印度独立和发展的贡献是不可否认的，他仍然是印度政治史上最受尊敬的人物之一。
objective.en: Historians generally regard Nehru as one of the most influential post-independence leaders in India, whose policies shaped the nation's developmental trajectory. In popular culture, Nehru is often depicted as a statesman with scholarly temperament, his red rose and goatee becoming iconic symbols. Despite controversies over his economic policies, his achievements in establishing democratic institutions and promoting education and scientific progress are widely recognized. Nehru's legacy is complex, marked by both successes and failures, but his contributions to India's independence and development are undeniable, making him one of the most revered figures in Indian political history.

self.zh: 生命短暂，历史长存。我们应当为历史而活，而不是为生命而活。
self.en: Life is short, history is long. We should live for history, not for life.
